name: k4-tasks
about: LumaScript tasks and wait in a mod built by lumalink build: a waiting on start is a task whose first step runs at start; tasks run after on frame in start order from the frame after their start (one started by on frame on its third frame first runs on the fourth); wait 1 frames, wait 0 frames (the next frame), wait 10 frames, wait 1 seconds (60 world steps), wait until a condition, wait on a task until it ends; t.stop() runs the task's defer at once and it runs no more; stop ends a task through its defer; an index error (S0902) ends only that task, its defer run; a task's text parameter lives with its frame
